name: Penda of Mercia
role: King of Mercia from c. 626 to 655
contribution: A 7th-century king of Mercia, the Anglo-Saxon kingdom in what is today the Midlands.
legacy: He repeatedly defeated the East Angles and drove Cenwalh, the king of Wessex, into exile for three years.

checks.lead: Penda (died 15 November 655) was a 7th-century king of Mercia, the Anglo-Saxon kingdom in what is today the Midlands. A pagan at a time when Christianity was taking hold in many of the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms, Penda took over the Severn Valley in 628 following the Battle of Cirencester before participating in the defeat of the powerful Northumbrian king Edwin at the Battle of Hatfield Chase in 633.
